sn55.50:1.1: Cattārimāni bhikkhave sotāpattiyaṅgāni || katamāni cattari || || Sappurisasaṃsevo saddhammasavanaṃ yonisomanasikāro dhammānudhammapaṭipatti || || Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni || || Sagāthakapuññābhisandavaggo pañcamo || ||
sn55.50:2.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Abhisandena tayo vuttā || Duve Mahaddhanena ca || Bhikkhu Nandiya Bhaddhiyam || Mahānām-Aṅgena te dasā ti || ||
